model.name: individual Dangerous Accessible Space

filters.directionNormalization: x and vx multiplied by explicit attacking direction; y and vy unchanged; author API receives +1; display x is restored

heatmap.source: accessible_space dangerous_result.player_poss_density multiplied by the author's radial cell widths (dr); an approximation of C_i(x) V(x), not a pass probability.
heatmap.interpolation: Periodic bilinear interpolation in the author's polar grid onto rectangular cell centres. Out-of-pitch source nodes are zero. Quantized to uint8 using a global fixed [0, 0.1] scale; larger values saturate. Display only; AS/DAS are the author's separate integrals.

momentDetector.name: causal-hysteresis-v1
momentDetector.meaning: Product notification rule, not a validated football quality threshold. Uses only observed numerical prefixes and occurred events. Windows split on invalid state, carrier or possession change.

model.parameterProvenance: Author API defaults from pinned 2.1.0, except explicit receiving-only carrier exclusion, direction, pitch, chunking and returned fields. Filter, display and window choices are product settings, not fitted model parameters.
